name: acetaminophen + dextromethorphan + saposhnikovia divaricata root + tangerine
purpose: minor aches and pain from colds, headache fever
uses: for adults take 1 pouch per intake, 3 times a day, before or between meals
otcwarn: Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
